caveats.zh: 名称或分类上下文不证明科学身份等同；根的三域标签仅保留该历史来源的表达。

statement.zh: 叠层石是微生物建造的结构，不是本树可对应的单一物种。
statement.en: Stromatolites are microbial structures, not a single species to match in this tree.

caveats.zh: 不把结构的年龄或产地赋给细菌、古菌或某个树节点。
caveats.en: The structure's age or locality is not assigned to bacteria, archaea or a tree node.

statement.zh: Cloudina在已取得的历史样本中未找到同名节点。
statement.en: No exact Cloudina label was found in the acquired historical sample.

caveats.zh: 这不是全源缺失证明；不根据壳体或动物类别添加枝条。
caveats.en: This does not prove absence from the full source; shells or animal category do not justify adding a branch.

statement.zh: 卡片科学名、PBDB名称事实与历史源标签均为Cycadales，只建立苏铁类的名称上下文。
statement.en: The card's scientific name, the PBDB name fact and the historical label are Cycadales; this establishes name context for cycads only.

caveats.zh: 名称一致不是正式分类身份等同；静态JSON未提供科学rank，不批准种级叶。
caveats.en: Matching labels are not formal taxonomic identity; the static JSON provides no scientific rank and no species-tip approval.

caveats.zh: 卡片的230至0 Ma范围不是Cycadales或Cycas revoluta的分化年代，也不批准Pseudoctenis化石映射。
caveats.en: The card's 230-0 Ma range is not a divergence age for Cycadales or Cycas revoluta, and does not approve a Pseudoctenis fossil mapping.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Prodeinotherium；不改用现生象节点。
statement.en: Prodeinotherium was not found in the sample; no living-elephant node is substituted.

caveats.zh: 属级化石和现生物种不能互换，地层范围不是节点年代。
caveats.en: A fossil genus and a living species are not interchangeable, and stratigraphic ranges are not node ages.

statement.zh: 已取得样本未找到Trilobita，不把节肢动物节点当作三叶虫叶。
statement.en: Trilobita was not found in the acquired sample; the arthropod node is not treated as a trilobite tip.

caveats.zh: 大类相似不构成该卡片的分类上下文证据；不能新增推测枝条。
caveats.en: A broad category alone is not evidence for this card's classification context; no inferred branch is added.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Anomalocaris，没有建立树关联。
statement.en: Anomalocaris was not found in the sample, so no tree association is established.

caveats.zh: 不凭外形或泛称节肢动物推断源节点身份。
caveats.en: Appearance or a broad arthropod description does not establish source-node identity.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Archaeocyatha，不改接某个现生海绵名称。
statement.en: Archaeocyatha was not found in the sample; no living-sponge label is substituted.

caveats.zh: 本选择集未核准古杯类的分类位置或分化年代。
caveats.en: This selection does not approve archaeocyath placement or divergence ages.

statement.zh: 未找到卡片原名Graptolithina，不用其他半索动物或现生名称替换。
statement.en: The card's exact Graptolithina label was not found; other hemichordate or living labels are not substituted.

caveats.zh: 同义名、名称修订和化石群的身份尚未对齐。
caveats.en: Synonyms, name revisions and fossil-group identity have not been aligned.

statement.zh: 卡片科学名、它自己的PBDB分类记录txn:26322与历史源标签均为Brachiopoda，只建立腕足动物的名称上下文。
statement.en: The card's scientific name, its own PBDB taxon record txn:26322 and the historical source label are Brachiopoda; only name context for brachiopods is established.

caveats.zh: 这是大类名称卡片；界面的species容器不证明它是单一物种。名称一致也不是跨数据库的形式身份等同。
caveats.en: This card names a broad group; the interface's species container does not establish a single species. Matching labels are not formal cross-database identity.

caveats.zh: 历史Brachiopoda节点有5个原始子节点，科学rank没有编码，不批准种级叶、逐边亲缘或现代共识。
caveats.en: The historical Brachiopoda node has five original children and no encoded scientific rank; no species tip, per-edge relationship or modern consensus is approved.

caveats.zh: PBDB化石出现包络及卡片年代不变成Brachiopoda分化时间；本卡片没有可核对的地点记录，名称关联不生成地图点或定位闭环。
caveats.en: PBDB fossil-occurrence envelopes and card ages do not become a Brachiopoda divergence time. This card has no verifiable locality record, so the name association creates no map point or location loop.

caveats.zh: PBDB的CC0只适用于归档分类数据响应，不扩展到所引Sepkoski论文的正文或图像。
caveats.en: PBDB's CC0 applies only to the archived taxon-data response, not to text or images in the cited Sepkoski publication.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Cooksonia；不挂接现生陆生植物叶。
statement.en: Cooksonia was not found in the sample; it is not attached to a living land-plant tip.

caveats.zh: 早期陆生植物背景不等于已核准的属级树映射。
caveats.en: Early land-plant context is not an approved genus-level tree mapping.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Dunkleosteus，不把脊椎动物名称当作其叶。
statement.en: Dunkleosteus was not found in the sample; a vertebrate label is not treated as its tip.

caveats.zh: 卡片的化石时代不能用于给历史节点定年。
caveats.en: The card's fossil interval cannot date a historical node.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Tiktaalik；未建立与Tetrapoda的分类上下文映射。
statement.en: Tiktaalik was not found in the sample; no classification-context mapping to Tetrapoda is established.

caveats.zh: 不能把过渡形态直接解释为某个现生类群的已确认祖先。
caveats.en: A transitional form is not automatically a confirmed ancestor of a living group.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Archaeopteris，不用现生蕨类或种子植物名称替代。
statement.en: Archaeopteris was not found in the sample; living fern or seed-plant names are not substituted.

caveats.zh: 木质树干和蕨状叶不能单独确定树中身份。
caveats.en: Woody trunks and fern-like foliage do not independently establish tree identity.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Lepidodendron，不把石炭纪煤林化石改接开花植物。
statement.en: Lepidodendron was not found in the sample; Carboniferous coal-forest fossils are not attached to flowering plants.

caveats.zh: 保留原卡片化石记录；其年代和坐标不转移到树内节点。
caveats.en: The original card's fossil records are retained; their ages and coordinates are not transferred to internal nodes.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Meganeura，不把Insecta当作巨脉蜻蜓叶。
statement.en: Meganeura was not found in the sample; Insecta is not treated as a Meganeura tip.

caveats.zh: 本批未另核该属的分类上下文，不能凭共同导航名补枝。
caveats.en: This batch does not separately verify the genus's classification context; a shared navigation category does not justify a branch.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Lystrosaurus，不改用Mammalia节点。
statement.en: Lystrosaurus was not found in the sample; Mammalia is not substituted.

caveats.zh: 未核准该化石属与历史树节点的分类身份或分化时间。
caveats.en: Classification identity or divergence timing between this fossil genus and a historical node is not approved.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Coelophysis；本批不把T. rex的属级证据外推到其他恐龙卡片。
statement.en: Coelophysis was not found in the sample; the T. rex genus-level evidence is not extended to other dinosaur cards.

caveats.zh: 每个新增分类上下文都需要自己的明确来源链。
caveats.en: Every additional classification context needs its own explicit source chain.

statement.zh: 该卡片自己的PBDB原件明确Diplodocus属txn:38669；新取得的Diplodocus carnegii原父链含同一属ID，并逐级连到Dinosauria txn:52775。因此仅关联历史Dinosauria名称作分类背景。
statement.en: The card's own PBDB record identifies the genus Diplodocus, txn:38669. The newly acquired original parent chain for Diplodocus carnegii contains that same genus ID and connects it step by step to Dinosauria, txn:52775. The historical Dinosauria label is linked as classification context only.

caveats.zh: 已取得的有限历史样本没有Diplodocus同名节点，这不是证明全树或所有分类数据库都不存在该名称。
caveats.en: The acquired bounded historical sample has no Diplodocus node; this does not establish absence from the full tree or every taxonomy database.

caveats.zh: 不能借霸王龙、鸟类或研究标题中的Dinosauria字样为梁龙补出分类父链，不把它们当作相同身份或伪造梁龙叶。
caveats.en: A Tyrannosaurus or bird lineage, or Dinosauria in a study title, cannot supply the Diplodocus classification chain. These are not identical entities, and no Diplodocus tip is fabricated.

caveats.zh: 这不是给历史树添加梁龙叶，也不等同PBDB与源i编号；属卡片的概略时间和化石包络都不是Dinosauria分化时间。
caveats.en: No Diplodocus tip is added to the historical tree, and PBDB IDs are not equated with source i IDs. Approximate genus-card ages and fossil envelopes are not Dinosauria divergence times.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Archaeopteryx；不将它直接对齐历史Aves节点。
statement.en: Archaeopteryx was not found in the sample; it is not directly aligned to the historical Aves node.

caveats.zh: Aves的源标签不批准现代冠群定义，也不证明始祖鸟是现生鸟类的直接祖先。
caveats.en: The Aves label does not approve a modern crown definition or establish Archaeopteryx as a direct ancestor of living birds.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Stegosaurus；没有借用其他恐龙的分类证据。
statement.en: Stegosaurus was not found in the sample; classification evidence for another dinosaur is not borrowed.

caveats.zh: 年代相近或同为恐龙不构成此条映射的证据。
caveats.en: Similar ages or the shared description dinosaur do not establish this mapping.

statement.zh: PBDB给出Tyrannosaurus rex的父属名称Tyrannosaurus；NCBI该属的谱系明确列出Dinosauria，因此仅关联历史Dinosauria名称作分类背景。
statement.en: PBDB supplies Tyrannosaurus as the parent label of Tyrannosaurus rex, and NCBI explicitly lists Dinosauria in that genus's lineage; the historical Dinosauria label is linked as classification context only.

caveats.zh: T. rex不是本静态样本的树叶；该关联不是把缺失物种嫁接到树上，也不是种级形式身份等同。
caveats.en: T. rex is not a tip in this static sample; the association neither grafts the missing species onto the tree nor establishes formal species identity.

caveats.zh: PBDB、NCBI与源i编号属于不同命名空间；不批准逐边亲缘、现代冠群定义或分化定年。
caveats.en: PBDB, NCBI and source i IDs occupy different namespaces; per-edge relationships, modern crown definitions and divergence dating are not approved.

caveats.zh: 68至66 Ma来自现有卡片的博物馆近似范围；66 Ma是故事的界线浏览切片，不是Dinosauria的节点年龄。
caveats.en: The approximate 68-66 Ma museum range belongs to the existing card; 66 Ma is the story's boundary browsing slice, not the age of Dinosauria.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Triceratops；66Ma的共同浏览时间不提供分类映射。
statement.en: Triceratops was not found in the sample; sharing the 66 Ma browsing slice does not provide a classification mapping.

caveats.zh: 不把T. rex案例的属级证据扩展为所有白垩纪恐龙的批准。
caveats.en: The T. rex case's genus-level evidence is not approval for all Cretaceous dinosaurs.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Ammonoidea，不改接现生头足动物名称。
statement.en: Ammonoidea was not found in the sample; living cephalopod labels are not substituted.

caveats.zh: 菊石类是群体卡片而非已确认种级叶；灭绝界线不是节点分化时间。
caveats.en: The ammonoid card describes a group, not an approved species tip; its extinction boundary is not a node divergence time.

statement.zh: 样本中未找到Deinotherium，不把它与Prodeinotherium或现生象合并。
statement.en: Deinotherium was not found in the sample; it is not merged with Prodeinotherium or living elephants.

caveats.zh: 相近中文名称和同属长鼻动物背景都不建立形式身份。
caveats.en: Similar common names or proboscidean context do not establish formal identity.

statement.zh: 该记录鉴定Prodeinotherium hobleyi，样本中未找到相应名称。
statement.en: The record identifies Prodeinotherium hobleyi; its label was not found in the sample.

caveats.zh: 属级卡片、这个种级记录和现生象不是可互换的身份；区域坐标保留在原记录。
caveats.en: The genus card, this species record and living elephants are not interchangeable identities; regional coordinates remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 本条是足迹与行走行为记录，不能指定为Homo sapiens树叶。
statement.en: This is a footprint and walking-behaviour record, not a Homo sapiens tip.

caveats.zh: 造迹者种级归属是背景解释；足迹层年龄不是人类分化年龄。
caveats.en: Species attribution is a contextual interpretation; the footprint layer's age is not a human divergence age.

statement.zh: A层石器记录人类活动，不代表一个已鉴定的树中物种。
statement.en: Stratum A tools record human activity, not an identified species in the tree.

caveats.zh: 不把A层石器年代赋给B层遗骸、Homo sapiens或树节点。
caveats.en: The tools' Stratum A chronology is not assigned to Stratum B remains, Homo sapiens or a tree node.

statement.zh: B层记录早期Homo遗骸，种级归属仍有讨论；不套用Homo sapiens原名。
statement.en: Stratum B records early Homo remains with debated species attribution; the Homo sapiens label is not imposed.

caveats.zh: 样本含Homo名称但不在选择集；它也不能解决该记录的种级身份。
caveats.en: The sample contains a Homo label outside the selection; that does not resolve the record's species identity.

statement.zh: 记录自己的MPI研究发布明确使用Homo sapiens，与历史源标签相同，仅建立遗骸解释的名称上下文。
statement.en: The record's own MPI announcement explicitly uses Homo sapiens, matching the historical label; only name context for the interpretation of the remains is established.

caveats.zh: 名称一致不证明与历史源节点形式身份等同，也不批准种级叶或现代冠群定义。
caveats.en: Matching names do not establish formal identity with the historical node, species-tip approval or a modern crown definition.

caveats.zh: 约315千年的主要测年来自相关受热燧石，不是每块人骨的直接年龄，更不是Homo sapiens节点分化年代。
caveats.en: The principal age of about 315 thousand years comes from associated heated flints, not a direct date for every bone or a divergence age for the Homo sapiens node.

caveats.zh: 不把其他人类活动、Laetoli足迹或Dmanisi遗骸一并映射到智人。
caveats.en: Other human activities, Laetoli footprints and Dmanisi remains are not also mapped to Homo sapiens.

statement.zh: 洞穴艺术与木炭记录人类活动，不据此指派树中物种。
statement.en: Cave art and charcoal record human activity; no species in the tree is assigned on that basis.

caveats.zh: 壁画动物不是动物化石证据，两段活动时间也不是节点年龄。
caveats.en: Depicted animals are not animal-fossil evidence, and the two activity phases are not node ages.

statement.zh: 源树确有Ursus spelaeus，但此记录自己的已归档论文摘要只写洞熊，未给出该科学名；精确Table 1值也缺少原始表格捕获，因此暂不建立关联或独立案例。
statement.en: The source tree contains Ursus spelaeus, but this record's archived paper abstract says only cave bears, without that scientific name. Exact Table 1 values also lack a raw table capture, so no association or independent case is enabled.

caveats.zh: 现有Table 1文件明确是既往核读的引用笔记，不是原始HTTP表格；论文HTML原件为访问验证页，不当作正文证据，也不重新尝试绕过。
caveats.en: The existing Table 1 file explicitly preserves earlier citation notes, not a raw HTTP table. The captured article HTML is an access challenge, not article evidence, and no bypass is retried.

caveats.zh: 不能从树内名称、其他卡片或通用洞熊资料替这个遗骸记录补出科学名。
caveats.en: A tree label, another card or generic cave-bear information cannot supply the scientific name for this remains record.

caveats.zh: 人类炭画和活动年代不能当作洞熊骨头年代；骨头日期、模型边界包络也不是洞熊源节点的分化年龄。
caveats.en: Human charcoal drawings and activity dates cannot date cave-bear bones; bone dates and model-boundary envelopes are not the source node's divergence age.

statement.zh: 建筑、石柱和象征活动不是可指派给单一树中物种的观察记录。
statement.en: Buildings, pillars and symbolic activity are not observations assignable to one species in the tree.

caveats.zh: 遗址年代与动物浮雕都不能用作物种身份或分化定年。
caveats.en: Site chronology and animal reliefs cannot establish species identity or divergence dating.

statement.zh: 这是公元79年城市与火山灾害事件，不是树中物种记录。
statement.en: This concerns a city and the volcanic disaster of 79 CE, not a species record in the tree.

caveats.zh: 事件时间与城市锚点不赋给任何生物节点。
caveats.en: The event date and city anchor are not assigned to any biological node.

statement.zh: 这是1995和1996年的人类保育行动，仍作为管理事件而非灰狼树叶。
statement.en: These are human conservation actions in 1995 and 1996; they remain management events, not gray-wolf tips.

caveats.zh: 不把重新引入日期解释为狼的起源年代，公园锚点也不是放生点。
caveats.en: Reintroduction dates are not wolf origin ages, and the park anchor is not a release site.

statement.zh: 原GBIF观察的species字段明确为Quercus robur，与历史源标签一致，只建立名称上下文。
statement.en: The original GBIF observation's species field explicitly says Quercus robur, matching the historical label; only name context is established.

caveats.zh: 原scientificName另含作者名L.；本关联使用独立的species原字段，不靠删作者名或同义名归并。
caveats.en: The original scientificName also includes the authorship L.; this association uses the separate original species field, not authorship stripping or synonym merging.

caveats.zh: 这是名称上下文而非形式身份等同；源Quercus robur有子节点，未知科学rank，不能当作已批准的种级叶。
caveats.en: This is name context, not formal identity; the source Quercus robur has children and no encoded scientific rank, so it is not an approved species tip.

caveats.zh: 原观察标为Unvalidated；2025年1月1日的所报日期、250米位置不确定度及未附媒体均沿用原记录，不证明2026年仍在原处。
caveats.en: The original observation is marked Unvalidated; its reported date of 1 January 2025, 250-metre coordinate uncertainty and lack of media remain with that record and do not prove presence there in 2026.

caveats.zh: 只有原记录的定位按钮可使用其位置；内节点没有坐标，名称关联不创造新地图点。
caveats.en: Only the original record's location button may use its position; internal nodes have no coordinates, and the name association creates no map point.

statement.zh: 已核读这条记录自己的2025年报：两套本地文字提取均未支持确切Canis lupus科学名，且PDF字体映射存在限制，因此仍不建立树关联。
statement.en: This record's own 2025 report was examined: neither of two local text extractions supports the exact scientific name Canis lupus, and PDF font mapping has limitations. No tree association is enabled.

caveats.zh: 这里只说明可提取文字没有支持精确科学名，不绝对断言PDF全部图像文字都没有该词；也不借其他网页、卡片或一般灰狼常识补名。
caveats.en: This establishes only that extractable text does not support the exact scientific name, not that every image glyph in the PDF lacks it. Other pages, cards or general knowledge about gray wolves cannot fill the name gap.

caveats.zh: 报告的2025年底群体概况及季节性调查，不是2025全年每天同样的数量，也不是某一天某只狼的观察；2026发表不等于2026实时数据。
caveats.en: The report's end-of-2025 population summary and seasonal studies do not establish identical daily counts throughout 2025 or a dated observation of an individual wolf. Publication in 2026 is not live 2026 data.

caveats.zh: 现有calendar月份、0Ma现代参考基图与公园区域锚点保留为原记录导航，不变成动物出现点或精确GPS监测点。
caveats.en: The existing calendar month, 0 Ma modern-reference basemap and park-region anchor remain record navigation, not animal occurrences or precise GPS monitoring points.

caveats.zh: Canis lupus源节点有17个子节点，不是已批准的种级叶；年度群体监测不是节点年龄或个体位置，缺名时不新增树案例。
caveats.en: The source Canis lupus has 17 children and is not an approved species tip; annual population monitoring is not a node age or individual location, and the name gap prevents a new tree case.

statement.zh: 原记录为Cloudina hartmannae，已取得样本未找到该名称。
statement.en: The original record names Cloudina hartmannae; that label was not found in the acquired sample.

caveats.zh: 不把属级Cloudina卡片、宽地层包络或壳体信息当作树中种级身份。
caveats.en: The genus-level Cloudina card, broad stratigraphic envelope and shell evidence do not establish species identity in the tree.

statement.zh: 原鉴定Lystrosaurus orientalis与接受名Lystrosaurus murrayi均未在样本中找到。
statement.en: Neither the original identification Lystrosaurus orientalis nor the accepted name Lystrosaurus murrayi was found in the sample.

caveats.zh: 保留数据库的鉴定与接受名差别，不臆造同义名跨库合并或接到哺乳动物。
caveats.en: The database's identification and accepted-name distinction is retained; no cross-database synonym merge or mammal attachment is invented.

statement.zh: 原化石记录接受为属级Pseudoctenis，样本中未找到；不能改作Cycas revoluta叶。
statement.en: The original fossil record is accepted at genus level as Pseudoctenis, which was not found in the sample; it cannot become a Cycas revoluta tip.

caveats.zh: 查询参数base_name=Cycadales不是该记录的接受科学名；化石叶不批准现生苏铁的种级身份或完整外形。
caveats.en: The query parameter base_name=Cycadales is not this record's accepted scientific name; a fossil leaf does not approve a living cycad's species identity or complete form.

statement.zh: Sheep Creek原occ:150350明确接受名Diplodocus carnegii、接受taxon ID txn:65917与原鉴定属Diplodocus。该种自己的新原父链从txn:65917经属txn:38669逐级连到Dinosauria txn:52775，支持历史名称的分类背景，不证明树中有梁龙叶。
statement.en: Original Sheep Creek occurrence occ:150350 gives the accepted name Diplodocus carnegii, accepted taxon ID txn:65917 and original identification genus Diplodocus. That species' newly acquired original parent chain connects txn:65917 through genus txn:38669 step by step to Dinosauria, txn:52775, supporting historical-label classification context, not a Diplodocus tip in the tree.

caveats.zh: 原地层标签Kimmeridgian至Tithonian、154.8至143.1 Ma包络与地点保留在该记录，不改成新版阶界或梁龙的完整生存期。
caveats.en: Original Kimmeridgian-through-Tithonian labels, the 154.8-143.1 Ma envelope and locality remain with this record, not newer stage boundaries or the full temporal range of Diplodocus.

caveats.zh: 真实发布的150 Ma离散地图快照是范围内浏览代表值，不证明此标本精确生活在那一年、每一年连续出现，或与所有同屏卡片在同一地点同时生活。
caveats.en: The genuinely published 150 Ma discrete map is a representative browsing value within the envelope, not proof that this specimen lived in that exact year, occurred continuously in every year, or shared a locality and instant with every onscreen card.

caveats.zh: 现有重建位点属于这处文献露头，误差未知；Dinosauria节点不获得化石年龄、坐标或虚构梁龙叶。位置、分类父链与历史拓扑是三种独立证据，不批准跨库身份或逐边亲缘。
caveats.en: The existing reconstructed position belongs to this published outcrop, with unknown uncertainty. Dinosauria gains no fossil age, coordinate or fabricated Diplodocus tip. Location, the classification chain and the historical topology are separate evidence, not approval of cross-database identity or per-edge phylogeny.

statement.zh: 原记录为Massospondylus carinatus，已取得样本中属名与种名均未找到。
statement.en: The original record names Massospondylus carinatus; neither the genus nor the species label was found in the acquired sample.

caveats.zh: 不借其他恐龙节点或一般分类常识把这条记录接到树上；宽地层包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: No other dinosaur node or general classification knowledge is used to attach the record to the tree; the broad stratigraphic envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Pleuromeia sternbergii，已取得样本中属名与种名均未找到。
statement.en: The original record names Pleuromeia sternbergii; neither the genus nor the species label was found in the acquired sample.

caveats.zh: 不借样本中更高级的石松类节点把这件化石植物接到树上；Induan地层包络与Ebro盆地采集区保留在原记录。
caveats.en: No higher lycopsid node in the sample is used to attach this fossil plant to the tree; the Induan stratigraphic envelope and Ebro Basin collection area remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为化石种Quercus convexa；样本中只有拼作quercus的无关种加词，没有Quercus属节点。
statement.en: The original record names the fossil species Quercus convexa; the sample contains only unrelated epithets spelled quercus, with no genus node Quercus.

caveats.zh: 不把现代栎树节点或形似的种加词当作这片化石叶在树中的身份；宽泛的渐新世至中新世包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: No modern oak node or look-alike epithet is treated as this fossil leaf's identity in the tree; the broad Oligocene-Miocene envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Bathyurellus pogonipensis，已取得样本中属名与种名均未找到；样本也未观察到Trilobita标签。
statement.en: The original record names Bathyurellus pogonipensis; neither the genus nor the species label was found in the acquired sample, and the Trilobita label was not observed in the sample either.

caveats.zh: 不借节肢动物等更高级节点或现有三叶虫卡片把这条记录接到树上；Whiterockian地层包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: Neither a higher node such as the arthropods nor the existing trilobite card is used to attach this record to the tree; the Whiterockian stratigraphic envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为属级鉴定Mucronaspis sp.，已取得样本中未找到Mucronaspis，也未观察到Trilobita标签。
statement.en: The original record is a genus-level identification, Mucronaspis sp.; Mucronaspis was not found in the acquired sample, and the Trilobita label was not observed either.

caveats.zh: 属级鉴定不提供种级身份；不借更高级节点把记录接到树上，Hirnantian地层包络与地区代表点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: A genus-level identification provides no species identity; no higher node is used to attach the record, and the Hirnantian envelope and district point remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Phacops natlensis，已取得样本中属名与种名均未找到，也未观察到Trilobita标签。
statement.en: The original record names Phacops natlensis; neither the genus nor the species label was found in the acquired sample, and the Trilobita label was not observed either.

caveats.zh: 不借更高级节点或其他三叶虫记录把这条记录接到树上；Early Emsian地层包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: No higher node or other trilobite record is used to attach this record to the tree; the Early Emsian stratigraphic envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Ameura missouriensis；已取得样本中未找到属名Ameura，样本中的missouriensis只是其他动植物的无关种加词。
statement.en: The original record names Ameura missouriensis; the genus Ameura was not found in the acquired sample, where missouriensis appears only as an unrelated epithet of other animals and plants.

caveats.zh: 不把同名种加词或更高级节点当作这件三叶虫化石在树中的身份；Gzhelian地层包络与露头位置保留在原记录。
caveats.en: Neither a look-alike epithet nor a higher node is treated as this trilobite fossil's identity in the tree; the Gzhelian stratigraphic envelope and outcrop position remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Lepidodendron aculeatum；植物样本的检索记录把Lepidodendron列为未找到，样本中的aculeatum只是其他类群的无关种加词。
statement.en: The original record names Lepidodendron aculeatum; the plant sample's query log lists Lepidodendron as not found, and aculeatum appears in the sample only as an unrelated epithet of other groups.

caveats.zh: 与现有鳞木卡片一样，不把开花植物或其他更高级节点当作这件化石在树中的身份；宽泛的宾夕法尼亚亚纪包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: As with the existing Lepidodendron card, no flowering-plant or other higher node is treated as this fossil's identity in the tree; the broad Pennsylvanian envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Nilssonia brevis；样本中的Nilssonia是现生鳖类（软壳龟）的一个属，属于动物中的同名异物，不是这类化石叶。
statement.en: The original record names Nilssonia brevis; the Nilssonia in the sample is a living softshell-turtle genus, an animal homonym, not this fossil leaf.

caveats.zh: 不把同名的龟类节点、Cycadales检索参数或现有苏铁卡片当作这片化石叶在树中的身份；Kimmeridgian地层包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: Neither the homonymous turtle node, the Cycadales query parameter nor the existing cycad card is treated as this fossil leaf's identity in the tree; the Kimmeridgian stratigraphic envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 原记录为Triceratops horridus，已取得样本中属名与种名均未找到。
statement.en: The original record names Triceratops horridus; neither the genus nor the species label was found in the acquired sample.

caveats.zh: 不借霸王龙案例的属级证据或现有三角龙卡片把这条记录接到树上；Late Maastrichtian地层包络与采集地点保留在原记录。
caveats.en: Neither the T. rex case's genus-level evidence nor the existing Triceratops card is used to attach this record to the tree; the Late Maastrichtian stratigraphic envelope and collection locality remain with the original record.

statement.zh: 尚未建立 Proterocladus antiquus 记录与历史树节点的可靠对应。
statement.en: No reliable mapping has been established between the Proterocladus antiquus record and a node of the historical tree.

caveats.zh: 不以更高级分类节点代替该化石记录的身份，也不把年代包络当成树节点年龄。

title.zh: 66Ma：从霸王龙记录进入恐龙的分类背景
title.en: 66 Ma: from the T. rex record to dinosaur classification context

question.zh: 树中没有霸王龙叶，为什么仍能从66Ma案例浏览Dinosauria？
question.en: Without a T. rex tip, why can the 66 Ma case still browse Dinosauria?

answer.zh: 物种记录和属级分类事实提供了一条有限的名称链，让我们浏览历史Dinosauria背景并返回撞击与食物网故事；这不是把霸王龙加入树，也不是给恐龙的分化定年。
answer.en: The species record and genus-level classification facts provide a limited name chain for browsing historical Dinosauria context and returning to the impact-and-food-webs story. They neither add T. rex to the tree nor date dinosaur divergence.

text.zh: PBDB物种记录txn:54833的名称为Tyrannosaurus rex，父属标签为Tyrannosaurus。
text.en: PBDB species record txn:54833 names Tyrannosaurus rex and supplies the parent label Tyrannosaurus.

text.zh: NCBI Tyrannosaurus属记录436494的LineageEx明确包含Dinosauria名称，支持分类背景而非亲缘枝条。
text.en: NCBI genus record 436494 for Tyrannosaurus explicitly includes the Dinosauria label in LineageEx, supporting classification context rather than a phylogenetic branch.

text.zh: 固定历史样本确有Dinosauria与其下的Aves原路径，但没有T. rex同名叶；原路径保留全部中间节点。
text.en: The pinned historical sample contains Dinosauria and an original path below it to Aves, but no exact T. rex tip; all intervening nodes are retained.

text.zh: 当前霸王龙卡片采用博物馆约68至66Ma的范围；66Ma仍是原撞击故事的界线浏览切片。
text.en: The current T. rex card uses the museum's approximate 68-66 Ma range; 66 Ma remains the original impact story's boundary browsing slice.

text.zh: 撞击扬起的物质和形成气溶胶的成分可以减少地表阳光，抑制光合作用，并改变远方食物网的供应。
text.en: Impact-lofted material and aerosol-forming components can reduce sunlight, suppress photosynthesis and alter food supplies in distant food webs.

caveats.zh: 本案例仅批准classification-context／supported-context，不批准T. rex树叶、逐边亲缘、直接祖先、现代冠群或分化年代。
caveats.en: This case approves only classification-context / supported-context, not a T. rex tip, per-edge relationship, direct ancestor, modern crown or divergence date.

caveats.zh: Aves只是固定2015来源的标签和路径；不由它推断所有鸟类都活过撞击，或哺乳动物撞击后才出现。
caveats.en: Aves is only a label and path in the pinned 2015 source; it does not imply that every bird survived the impact or that mammals first appeared afterwards.

caveats.zh: 地图的66Ma、化石出现区间与灭绝事件时间不转换成树的node age；树不定年且没有逐边研究支持。
caveats.en: The map's 66 Ma slice, fossil-occurrence intervals and extinction timing are not converted to node ages; the tree is undated and lacks per-edge study support.

caveats.zh: 树内节点没有坐标；返回地图只使用霸王龙原卡片的既有记录和定位入口。
caveats.en: Internal nodes have no coordinates; returning to the map uses only the T. rex card's existing records and location controls.

caveats.zh: 该有限样本不含Archaeopteryx或Diplodocus；不为它们补造叶或借用本案例的证据。
caveats.en: The bounded sample lacks Archaeopteryx and Diplodocus; their tips are not fabricated and this case's evidence is not borrowed for them.

title.zh: 现代记录：夏栎名称不是树的年龄
title.en: Modern record: an oak name is not a tree age

question.zh: 一条2025年夏栎观察，能告诉我们什么，又不能告诉什么？
question.en: What can a 2025 pedunculate-oak observation tell us, and what can it not?

answer.zh: 原观察的Quercus robur名称可以连到历史同名节点，并返回原记录核对日期与位置说明。观察日期不是个体树龄或谱系年龄；名字相同也不构成跨数据库身份认证。
answer.en: The observation's Quercus robur name can lead to the historical label and back to the original record's date and location notes. An observation date is neither an individual tree age nor a lineage age, and matching names are not cross-database identity certification.

text.zh: GBIF观察5004569926的species原字段为Quercus robur，与历史节点source-143065的源标签一致。
text.en: The original species field of GBIF occurrence 5004569926 says Quercus robur, matching the source label of historical node source-143065.

text.zh: 原记录是人工观察，所报日期为2025年1月1日；位置不确定度为250米，且没有附带观察媒体。
text.en: The original record is a human observation dated 1 January 2025, with 250 metres of coordinate uncertainty and no attached observation media.

text.zh: 历史Quercus robur有3个子节点，Quercus petraea是另一个源标签；不能因为它们都出现在栎的原路径下而视为同一物种身份。
text.en: The historical Quercus robur has three children, and Quercus petraea is a separate source label; appearing below the original Quercus path does not make them the same species identity.

text.zh: 原观察标注Unvalidated；名称导航不提高其鉴定验证等级，也不增加新的地点或树龄。
text.en: The original observation is marked Unvalidated; name navigation does not improve its identification-validation status or add a locality or tree age.

caveats.zh: 本案例只批准exact-name-context／supported-context，不批准形式分类身份、种级叶、科学rank或分化定年。
caveats.en: This case approves only exact-name-context / supported-context, not formal taxonomic identity, a species tip, scientific rank or divergence dating.

caveats.zh: 0Ma是现代底图的浏览入口，不是虚构章节，也不是树节点的0Ma年龄。
caveats.en: 0 Ma is an entry to the modern basemap, not an invented chapter or a zero-age tree node.

caveats.zh: 只有原记录的按钮可以定位其附有不确定度的位置；Quercus内节点和旁边名称不会生成坐标。
caveats.en: Only the original record's button can locate its uncertainty-qualified position; the Quercus internal node and neighbouring labels generate no coordinates.

caveats.zh: 一条观察不证明个体年龄、连续存在、当地原生性、2026年仍在原地或该点的全部植物分布。
caveats.en: One observation does not establish individual age, continuous presence, local native status, continued presence in 2026 or the distribution of all plants there.

caveats.zh: 双语名称只是导航别名；保留Quercus robur及Quercus petraea原源拼写，不进行同义名或作者名推断合并。
caveats.en: Bilingual names are navigation aliases only; original Quercus robur and Quercus petraea spellings are retained without inferred synonym or authorship merging.

title.zh: Jebel Irhoud：燧石测年，不是智人的树节点年龄
title.en: Jebel Irhoud: dating flints, not a Homo sapiens node

question.zh: 为什么315±34千年的受热燧石年龄，不能直接写到Homo sapiens树节点上？
question.en: Why cannot the heated-flint age of 315 +/- 34 thousand years be assigned directly to the Homo sapiens node?

answer.zh: 研究对与新发现遗骸直接相关的受热燧石进行热释光测年，约束这组考古证据的年代。遗骸的Homo sapiens名称可浏览历史同名节点，但名称上下文没有提供谱系分化时间，也不表示每块人骨都直接测得同一年龄。
answer.en: Thermoluminescence dating of heated flints directly associated with the newly discovered remains constrains this archaeological evidence. The remains' Homo sapiens name can lead to the historical label, but name context supplies no lineage divergence time and does not mean every bone was directly dated to the same age.

text.zh: Richter等人报告与Jebel Irhoud新遗骸直接相关的受热燧石热释光测年，加权年龄为315±34 ka。
text.en: Richter and colleagues report thermoluminescence dating of heated flints directly associated with the new Jebel Irhoud remains, with a weighted age of 315 +/- 34 ka.

text.zh: 该记录自己的MPI研究发布将这些新发现遗骸称为Homo sapiens；这里沿用这一明确名称作上下文，而非认证跨数据库身份。
text.en: The record's own MPI announcement names the newly discovered remains Homo sapiens; that explicit name supplies context here, not cross-database identity certification.

text.zh: 历史静态JSON的source-463273原名为Homo sapiens，但该原节点没有绝对年龄或分化年代字段。
text.en: Historical static JSON names source-463273 Homo sapiens, but the original node contains no absolute-age or divergence-date field.

caveats.zh: 本例仅沿用已核准的exact-name-context／supported-context，不批准种级叶、形式身份、现代冠群定义、直接祖先关系或分化定年。
caveats.en: This case uses only the approved exact-name-context / supported-context, not approval of a species tip, formal identity, modern crown definition, direct ancestry or divergence dating.

caveats.zh: 0.315 Ma对应原记录真实发布的irhoud-0-315-ma入口、原生Ma时间与已有重建位置，不借0Ma现代特例，也不添加虚构章节或epoch字段。
caveats.en: 0.315 Ma corresponds to the record's genuinely published irhoud-0-315-ma entry, native Ma time and existing reconstructed position. It does not borrow the 0 Ma modern exception or add an invented chapter or epoch field.

caveats.zh: 0.315只是浏览代表值；315±34 ka的不确定性不变成确定的连续居住期、个体寿命或物种起止时间，也不混合其他测年方法扩成范围。
caveats.en: 0.315 is a representative browsing value; uncertainty in 315 +/- 34 ka is not a proven continuous occupation period, individual lifespan or species range, and other dating methods are not combined to extend it.

caveats.zh: 只有原遗骸记录的按钮可使用已有地点。遗址中心索引和重建位点不是某根人骨或炉火的实测坐标，测量误差未知；树内节点不获得坐标。
caveats.en: Only the original remains record's button may use the existing locality. The site-centre index and reconstructed position are not surveyed coordinates for a bone or fire, and measurement uncertainty is unknown; internal tree nodes gain no coordinates.

caveats.zh: 一处早期遗骸记录不是全人类唯一的出生地点，也不能把那一时刻当作演化完成或智人谱系分化的瞬间。
caveats.en: One early-remains record is not humanity's sole birthplace, nor an instant when evolution finished or the Homo sapiens lineage diverged.

title.zh: 150 Ma：梁龙化石的地层年代，不是恐龙的树年龄
title.en: 150 Ma: a Diplodocus fossil's stratigraphic age, not a dinosaur tree age

question.zh: Sheep Creek梁龙记录为什么能连到Dinosauria，却不能给这个树节点写上150 Ma？
question.en: Why can the Sheep Creek Diplodocus record lead to Dinosauria without dating that tree node to 150 Ma?

answer.zh: 同一PBDB命名空间中，原化石记录的Diplodocus carnegii txn:65917与自己的分类父链相接，经Diplodocus属逐级到Dinosauria，提供分类背景。154.8至143.1 Ma来自原化石地层包络，150 Ma只是其中已有地图浏览值；两者都不是谱系分化时间。
answer.en: Within the same PBDB namespace, the original fossil record's Diplodocus carnegii, txn:65917, joins its own classification chain through the genus Diplodocus to Dinosauria, supplying classification context. The original fossil's stratigraphic envelope is 154.8-143.1 Ma, and 150 Ma is an existing map-browsing value within it; neither is a lineage divergence time.

text.zh: 原PBDB occ:150350、col:13352记载Sheep Creek露头，接受名Diplodocus carnegii与taxon ID txn:65917，原鉴定属／种字段为Diplodocus／carnegii。
text.en: Original PBDB occ:150350, col:13352, records the Sheep Creek outcrop, accepted name Diplodocus carnegii and taxon ID txn:65917, with original identification genus/species fields Diplodocus/carnegii.

text.zh: 新原响应明确txn:65917的父属为Diplodocus txn:38669；沿每个par ID并核对prl名称，经过全部中间分类记录到Dinosauria txn:52775。
text.en: The new original response explicitly gives Diplodocus, txn:38669, as the parent genus of txn:65917. Following every par ID and checking its prl name passes through all intervening taxonomic records to Dinosauria, txn:52775.

text.zh: 原化石记录保留Kimmeridgian至Tithonian标签和154.8至143.1 Ma数值包络。150 Ma已有同模型重建点，但原数据库没有把该个体精确测到150 Ma。
text.en: The original fossil record retains Kimmeridgian-through-Tithonian labels and a 154.8-143.1 Ma numerical envelope. An existing same-model reconstructed point is available at 150 Ma, but the database does not date this individual exactly to 150 Ma.

text.zh: 固定2015历史树确有Dinosauria源名称，仍没有Diplodocus同名节点；这里仅浏览既有名称的分类背景，不改原树边。
text.en: The pinned 2015 historical tree contains the source label Dinosauria but still has no Diplodocus node. This only browses an existing label's classification context without changing original tree edges.

caveats.zh: 本例仅批准classification-context／supported-context，不添加梁龙叶，不等同PBDB与源i编号，不批准逐边亲缘、直接祖先、现代冠群定义或分化定年。
caveats.en: This case approves only classification-context / supported-context. It adds no Diplodocus tip, equates no PBDB and source i IDs, and approves no per-edge phylogeny, direct ancestry, modern crown definition or divergence dating.

caveats.zh: 150 Ma来自已有侏罗纪章节及真实切片，不是新观察日期；原地层包络不是该个体寿命、逐年连续出现或梁龙属完整生存期。
caveats.en: 150 Ma comes from an existing Jurassic chapter and real slice, not a new observation date. The original stratigraphic envelope is not this individual's lifespan, continuous annual occurrence or the genus's complete temporal range.

caveats.zh: 定位只使用原Sheep Creek记录的文献露头及已有同模型重建位点，实测误差未知；不是骨骼精确出土点，树内节点不获得坐标。
caveats.en: Location uses only the original Sheep Creek record's published outcrop and existing same-model reconstructed point, with unknown measured uncertainty. It is not a precise bone-excavation position, and internal tree nodes gain no coordinates.

caveats.zh: 2026年的分类响应采集时间不是侏罗纪化石年龄；2025现代入口不显示梁龙。未重读Hatcher原论文，不将数据库许可扩展到论文图片或标本扫描。
caveats.en: The 2026 classification-response capture time is not the Jurassic fossil's age, and Diplodocus is not shown in the modern 2025 entry. Hatcher's original paper was not reread, and database licensing does not extend to paper figures or specimen scans.
